context_requirements: Expression of PKM2 or PKM1 in the cell line
Active glycolytic flux and dependence on pyruvate kinase for ATP production
Presence of the allosteric activation pocket in PKM
Cellular context where PKM activation alters metabolic flux (e.g., high glycolytic rate)
falsifiers: No change in any glycolytic or lipogenic gene at 24 h in any cell line
Strong and consistent upregulation of proliferation markers at 24 h
Clear transcriptional response at 6 h that is not seen at 24 h
No difference in response between HEPG2 and other lines
